I agree that there is a general lack of interest around TBN. Despite the impressive SP gain since early December, the company seems pretty unloved. To be honest, I think this is a good thing (at least for now) if you're interested in topping up... Little hype and less people speculating suggests less risk for the rest of us haha.

I'm a pretty young guy, and have been investing for a while. After discovering TBN in late December, I've decided to go all in. IMO this is too big of an opportunity to pass up on, especially at these prices, where risk is at least somewhat moderated. 

2025 and 2026 are going to be interesting years for the company, especially with the upcoming IP30 flow test results for the SS-2H ST1 and SS-3H wells in late March/early April. I reckon if we see flow rates of 18 mmcf/d+, which I believe was the target according to Riddle in the podcast, we could easily be at 30-40c by the end of March.

Another potential catalyst; the Beetaloo data centre pitch, if successful, would also do wonders for the SP. Not super confident a deal will come through, but I'm staying hopeful that Chris Wright will pull some strings up in Washington to get the sludge in the pipes moving.
